beginner.summary: For technical and business participants new to generative AI. Covers how large language models work, writing good prompts, using chat assistants safely at work, calling a model API from Python and building a first small AI application.
prerequisites: Comfortable using a computer and web applications
Basic Python is helpful for the API days but not required for the first week
Access to a chat assistant and an API key or a local Ollama install
outcomes: Explain how LLMs generate text and where they fail
Write prompts that give reliable, structured answers
Use generative AI safely for documents, data and code
Build a small Python application that calls an LLM API

days.topic: Generative AI Overview and Course Setup
subtopics: What generative AI is and what it is not
Text, image, audio and code generation
Large language models in plain terms
Well-known models: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral
Chat assistants versus APIs versus local models
Typical business uses and where they fail
Setting up a chat assistant account
Installing Ollama and running a local model
Setting up Python and a Jupyter notebook
Course project and ground rules for data
days.lab_task: Run the same five tasks (summary, email draft, table extraction, translation and arithmetic) in a hosted chat assistant and a local Ollama model, record the results and mark where each one is wrong.
days.deliverable: Comparison table of five tasks across two models with errors marked
checks: Run a local model with Ollama
Model answers a prompt on the participant's machine
Ask both models a multi-step arithmetic question
At least one wrong answer is identified and explained
Explain the difference between a chat assistant and an API
Correct explanation in the participant's words
objectives: Explain what generative AI can and cannot do
Set up the tools for the course

days.topic: How Large Language Models Work: Tokens, Training and Prediction
days.lab_task: Count tokens for the same paragraph in English and Hindi, run one prompt ten times at temperature 0 and 1, and produce three hallucinations about a made-up company with an explanation of why they happen.
days.deliverable: Token counts, variability results and a hallucination log
checks: Run a prompt ten times at temperature 0
Answers are identical or nearly identical
Run it ten times at temperature 1
Answers vary, and the variation is described
Ask about an event after the knowledge cut-off
Participant identifies the made-up or outdated answer

days.topic: Prompt Writing Essentials
subtopics: Asking for a format: lists, tables, JSON
Telling the model what not to do
days.lab_task: Improve three weak prompts (a customer email, a meeting summary and a product description) through at least four versions each, scoring every version against a short checklist.
days.deliverable: Prompt versions with scores and the final prompts
checks: Score the first and final versions
Final versions score higher on every checklist item
Ask for a table with fixed columns
Output has exactly the requested columns
Swap in a new customer email
Final prompt still gives a usable reply

days.topic: Prompt Patterns for Reasoning and Reliable Answers
subtopics: Asking the model to check its own answer
Giving the model a way to say "I don't know"
Grounding answers in a pasted document
Quoting sources from the provided text
days.lab_task: Answer 15 questions about a provided 10-page policy document using a grounding prompt that must quote the supporting sentence or say the answer is not in the document.
days.deliverable: Grounding prompt, answers with quotes and an accuracy count
checks: Ask a question the document does not answer
Model says it is not in the document
Check every quote against the document
All quotes appear word for word
Compare accuracy with and without the grounding prompt
Grounding prompt gives more correct answers

days.topic: Generative AI for Documents, Email and Meetings
subtopics: Comparing two versions of a document
days.lab_task: Turn a provided meeting transcript into minutes with decisions and action items, draft three follow-up emails in different tones and compare two contract versions to list every change.
days.deliverable: Minutes, three emails and a change list
checks: Compare action items with the transcript
Every action item has an owner and date found in the transcript
Compare the change list with a diff tool
All real changes are listed with no invented ones
Rewrite one email for a senior reader
Shorter and more formal, with the same facts
objectives: Use generative AI for daily office work

days.topic: Generative AI for Data Analysis and Spreadsheets
subtopics: Asking for formulas and explaining them
Cleaning messy data with AI help
Generating charts with a code interpreter
days.lab_task: Clean and analyse a provided sales spreadsheet with AI help, produce three charts and a summary, and verify every number in the summary against your own spreadsheet formulas.
days.deliverable: Cleaned spreadsheet, charts and a checked summary
checks: Recompute the summary totals with spreadsheet formulas
Ask for a formula that finds duplicates
Point out one wrong AI claim

days.topic: Generative AI for Code
subtopics: AI coding assistants in the editor
tools: GitHub Copilot or a coding assistant
days.lab_task: Use an AI assistant to explain a provided Python script, write tests for it, find and fix two planted bugs and convert one function to JavaScript, reviewing every suggestion before accepting it.
days.deliverable: Tests, fixed script, converted function and a review log
checks: Run the AI-written tests on the original script
Run the tests after the fixes
Reason for rejecting it is given
objectives: Use AI to read and write code

days.topic: Image, Audio and Multimodal Generation
days.lab_task: Generate four marketing images for a product within brand rules, extract data from a photographed invoice with a vision model and transcribe a five-minute audio clip, checking each output.
days.deliverable: Images with prompts, extracted invoice fields and a checked transcript
checks: Compare extracted invoice fields with the photo
All fields correct or errors marked
Measure transcript errors on one minute of audio
Check images against the brand rules
Each rule is met or the image is regenerated

days.topic: Responsible AI, Privacy and Company Policy
subtopics: What data not to paste into AI tools
Regulation overview: EU AI Act and India's DPDP Act
days.lab_task: Review ten workplace scenarios, decide whether each AI use is allowed under a sample company policy, fix the unsafe ones and test a model for bias with paired prompts.
days.deliverable: Scenario decisions with reasons and a bias test record
checks: At least nine match the policy answer key
Personal data removed and still useful
objectives: Use AI within policy and law

days.topic: Calling an LLM API from Python
subtopics: Reading the response and token usage
Calling a local model through Ollama's API
days.lab_task: Write a Python script that sends a prompt to a hosted model and to a local Ollama model, prints the answer, token usage and estimated cost, and retries on rate-limit errors.
days.deliverable: Script, sample output and a cost estimate for 1,000 calls
checks: Run the script without the API key set
Run the script against both models
Both answers and token counts are printed
Calculation uses the measured token counts

days.topic: Structured Output and JSON from LLMs
subtopics: Why free text is hard for programs
days.lab_task: Extract name, date, amount and category from 30 sample invoices into Pydantic objects, retry when validation fails and measure accuracy against the answer file.
days.deliverable: Extraction script, results file and accuracy report
checks: At least 90 percent of fields correct
Feed a document that is not an invoice
Returns the "not an invoice" label instead of made-up fields

days.topic: Building a Chat Application with Conversation Memory
subtopics: Trimming history to fit the context window
A simple web interface with Streamlit
days.lab_task: Build a Streamlit chat assistant for a company FAQ that streams answers, remembers the conversation, trims old messages when the history gets long and logs token usage per conversation.
days.deliverable: Chat application and a recorded demo
checks: Ask a follow-up question that refers to an earlier answer
History is trimmed and the app keeps working
Token count per conversation is recorded

days.topic: Embeddings and Semantic Search
subtopics: Creating embeddings with an API or a local model
Storing vectors in a simple index
days.lab_task: Embed 200 support tickets, build a semantic search that finds similar tickets for a new one, compare it with keyword search on ten queries and group the tickets into topics.
days.deliverable: Search script, comparison table and topic groups
checks: Search with a query that uses different words from the ticket
Semantic search finds it, keyword search does not
Rank the top five results for ten queries
At least 8 of 10 have a relevant first result
Each group has a sensible label

days.topic: Grounding Answers with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
subtopics: Checking answer quality on test questions
days.lab_task: Build a question-answering assistant over a provided HR policy folder that retrieves relevant chunks, answers with citations and refuses when the answer is not in the documents.
days.deliverable: RAG script, 20 test questions and results
checks: At least 16 correct with a correct citation
Ask a question the policies do not cover
Assistant says it cannot find the answer

days.topic: Tool Calling and Simple Agents
subtopics: Running the tool and returning results
Several tool calls in a row
days.lab_task: Give a model three tools (weather lookup, currency conversion and a calendar search) and build a loop that answers travel questions by calling them, with a step limit and a log of every call.
days.deliverable: Agent script, tool definitions and call logs
checks: Ask a question that needs two tools
Both tools are called and the answer uses both results
Ask a question that needs no tools
Answered directly with no tool call
Agent reports the failure instead of inventing data

days.topic: Evaluating Generative AI Outputs
subtopics: Why "it looks good" is not enough
Test sets of questions and expected answers
Exact match, keyword and similarity checks
Using a model as a judge
days.lab_task: Build a test set of 30 questions for the FAQ assistant, score two prompts and two models with automatic checks and a model judge, and pick the best combination on quality, cost and speed.
days.deliverable: Test set, evaluation results and a recommendation
checks: Run the evaluation on two prompts
Scores are reported per question and overall
Compare the model judge with your own marks on ten answers
Choice is supported by quality, cost and latency numbers
objectives: Compare prompts and models with evidence

days.topic: AI Safety Risks: Prompt Injection, Data Leaks and Jailbreaks
subtopics: Indirect injection through documents and web pages
days.lab_task: Attack your own FAQ assistant with ten prompt injection and data-leak attempts, record which succeed, add defences and rerun the attacks.
days.deliverable: Attack log before and after the defences
checks: Hide an instruction in a retrieved document
Injection succeeds before and is blocked after
Ask the assistant to reveal its system prompt
Fewer succeed than before, with the rest explained

days.topic: Choosing Models: Hosted, Open-Weight and Small Models
subtopics: Open-weight models: Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma
days.lab_task: Run the evaluation test set against one hosted model and two local models of different sizes, measure quality, speed and cost, and fill in a model selection checklist for a given use case.
days.deliverable: Results table and completed selection checklist
checks: Measure tokens per second for each model
Run the test set on each model
Quality score recorded for all three
Choose a model for a privacy-sensitive use case
objectives: Choose a model for a use case

days.topic: Generative AI Use Cases and Business Value
subtopics: Build, buy or use an existing tool
days.lab_task: Pick a process from your own work, estimate time and cost saved with and without AI, list the risks, and write a one-page pilot proposal with success measures.
days.deliverable: One-page pilot proposal with an estimate sheet
checks: Savings are based on stated, checkable assumptions
Covers data, accuracy and adoption risks
Present the proposal in three minutes
Success measures are clear and measurable

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: AI Assistant for a Business Team
days.lab_task: Build an assistant for one team (HR, sales or support) that answers from its documents with citations, fills a structured form from emails, passes a 20-question test set and blocks basic injection attempts, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Application, test set results, safety test log and a 10-minute demo
checks: Paste an email into the form filler
All required fields are filled and valid
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one application

intermediate.summary: For developers who have called an LLM API. Covers production application design: provider abstraction, advanced prompting, structured output, RAG, tool use, evaluation, guardrails, observability, cost control and deployment of generative AI services.
prerequisites: Writes Python confidently, including APIs and packages
Has called an LLM API and built a small prompt-based script
Knows basic web APIs and JSON
outcomes: Design and build production-style LLM applications
Add guardrails, monitoring and cost controls
Deploy a generative AI service as an API

days.topic: Generative AI Application Architecture
subtopics: Prompt layer, retrieval layer, tool layer
Reference architectures on AWS, Azure and GCP
days.lab_task: Design the architecture of a customer-support assistant, then build a FastAPI service with a provider-independent client that falls back to a second model when the first one fails.
days.deliverable: Architecture diagram, service code and failover demo
checks: Requests are served by the fallback model
Every component and data flow is labelled

days.topic: Advanced Prompt Engineering for Developers
days.lab_task: Turn the support assistant's single prompt into a versioned chain (classify, retrieve, answer, check), choose few-shot examples dynamically and prove the chain beats the single prompt on the test set.
days.deliverable: Prompt chain code, versioned templates and evaluation results
checks: Run both versions on the test set
Test run shows the effect of the change
Compressed prompt uses fewer tokens with the same score

days.topic: Structured Outputs, Function Schemas and Data Extraction at Scale
subtopics: Human review queues for low confidence
days.lab_task: Process 1,000 purchase orders into nested Pydantic records with the batch API, route low-confidence records to a review queue and report accuracy per field.
days.deliverable: Pipeline code, review queue and accuracy report
checks: All outputs validate or go to the review queue
Compare cost with the standard API

days.topic: Production RAG: Chunking, Hybrid Search and Reranking
days.lab_task: Rebuild the policy assistant with metadata filters, hybrid search and a reranker, and show the change in retrieval recall and answer accuracy on a 50-question test set.
days.deliverable: RAG service, retrieval metrics and answer accuracy before and after
checks: Measure retrieval recall@5 before and after
Only that department's documents are used

days.topic: Document Ingestion Pipelines: PDFs, Office Files and Web Pages
subtopics: Tables as text or structured data
days.lab_task: Build an ingestion pipeline for a folder of mixed PDFs, Office files and scanned pages that keeps tables, removes boilerplate, records the source page and only reprocesses files that changed.
days.deliverable: Pipeline code, sample chunks with metadata and a quality report
checks: Ingest the folder twice with one file changed
Only the changed file is reprocessed
Inspect a chunk from a table
Table rows and headers are kept
Boilerplate does not appear in chunks

days.topic: LLM Frameworks in Practice: LangChain and LlamaIndex
subtopics: What frameworks add and what they hide
When to use plain SDK calls instead
days.lab_task: Rebuild the policy assistant twice, once with LangChain and once with LlamaIndex, compare code size, quality and latency with the plain SDK version and recommend one for the team.
days.deliverable: Two implementations, comparison table and recommendation
checks: Run the 50-question test set on all three versions
Swap the vector store in each framework
Done through configuration with tests still passing
Based on measured quality, latency and maintenance

days.topic: Model Context Protocol: Connecting Assistants to Tools and Data
subtopics: What MCP is and why it exists
Tools, resources and prompts in MCP
Writing an MCP server in Python
Connecting MCP servers to assistants and IDEs
Logging and limits for MCP tools
days.lab_task: Write an MCP server that exposes read-only order lookup and a document search resource, connect it to an assistant, and add authentication and per-tool rate limits.
days.deliverable: MCP server code, connection configuration and a demo
checks: Ask the assistant for an order status
It calls the MCP tool and answers with the real status

days.topic: Function Calling and Tool Integration with Business Systems
subtopics: Database query tools with safety limits
days.lab_task: Connect the support assistant to an order API with read tools and a refund tool that needs user confirmation, validate every argument and keep an audit log of every call.
days.deliverable: Tool code, audit log and a demo of the confirmation flow
checks: Ask for a refund above the limit
Assistant asks for confirmation and the tool enforces the limit
Send a tool argument with a SQL injection string
Every call shows user, tool, arguments and result

days.topic: Automated Evaluation Pipelines for LLM Applications
subtopics: RAG metrics: faithfulness and answer relevance
days.lab_task: Add an evaluation suite with faithfulness, relevance and rubric scores to the assistant's repository and make CI fail when a pull request lowers the score by more than three points.
days.deliverable: Evaluation suite, CI workflow and a failing and a passing pull request
checks: Open a pull request with a worse prompt
CI fails on the score drop
Open a pull request with a better prompt
CI passes and reports the gain
Compare judge scores with human marks on 20 answers

days.topic: Guardrails and Content Safety
days.lab_task: Add input and output guardrails to the assistant that block off-topic requests, mask personal data and detect injection, then measure how many safe requests are wrongly blocked.
days.deliverable: Guardrail configuration, test results and false block rate
checks: Send a request containing a phone number
Number is masked in logs and output

days.topic: Observability and Tracing for LLM Applications
subtopics: Tracing prompts, retrieval and tool calls
Token, latency and cost per request
days.lab_task: Instrument the assistant with Langfuse traces for every step, capture thumbs up and down from users, and use the traces to find and fix the cause of the three worst-rated answers.
days.deliverable: Tracing setup, dashboard and three fixed issues with trace evidence
checks: Shows prompt, retrieval, tool calls, tokens and latency
List of poor answers with traces

days.topic: Cost and Latency Optimisation
days.lab_task: Cut the assistant's cost per conversation by at least 40 percent with routing, prompt caching and a semantic cache while keeping the evaluation score within one point.
days.deliverable: Cost and latency report before and after with evaluation scores
checks: Score within one point of before

days.topic: Multimodal Applications: Documents, Images and Speech
subtopics: Vision models for documents and screenshots
Cost and accuracy of multimodal calls
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that reads scanned insurance claims with tables and handwriting, extracts fields, transcribes an attached voice note and compares accuracy of a vision model and a document AI service.
days.deliverable: Pipeline code and an accuracy comparison
checks: Fields extracted for all with accuracy recorded
Transcripts attached to the right claims
Compare vision model and document AI
Better choice per field type explained
objectives: Compare approaches by accuracy and cost

days.topic: Working with Open-Weight Models and Local Inference
subtopics: Running models with Ollama and vLLM
Hardware sizing for GPU and CPU
When local models are the right choice
days.lab_task: Serve an open-weight model with vLLM in Docker behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, switch the assistant to it with configuration only and compare quality, speed and cost with the hosted model.
days.deliverable: Serving setup, comparison report and licence notes
checks: Point the assistant at the local endpoint

days.topic: Fine-Tuning Essentials: When and How
subtopics: Supervised fine-tuning through a provider API
LoRA fine-tuning of an open model
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a small model to classify support tickets into 12 categories with 1,000 examples, compare it with a few-shot prompt on a held-out test set and calculate the cost of each approach.
days.deliverable: Training data, fine-tuned model, comparison and cost sheet
checks: Fine-tuned and prompt accuracy both reported
Check for leakage between train and test

days.topic: Building Generative AI APIs with FastAPI
subtopics: Authentication and rate limits per user
days.lab_task: Expose the assistant as a FastAPI service with streaming answers, per-user rate limits, a background job for document ingestion and OpenAPI docs, then load-test it.
days.deliverable: API code, OpenAPI page and load test report
checks: Call the streaming endpoint with curl
Tokens arrive as they are generated
Run a load test with 50 users
Error rate and p95 latency recorded

days.topic: Deploying Generative AI Services on the Cloud
subtopics: Managed model services: Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI
Containers on Cloud Run, Container Apps or ECS
Blue-green deployment of prompts and models
days.lab_task: Deploy the assistant in a container to one cloud using its managed model service through a private endpoint, with keys in a secret store and a staged rollout of a new prompt version.
days.deliverable: Deployment files, endpoint URL and rollout record
checks: Call the model endpoint from the public internet
Roll out a new prompt to 10 percent of traffic
Only that share uses the new version
No keys in code or images
objectives: Deploy LLM services to the cloud

days.topic: Data Privacy, Security and Compliance for LLM Systems
subtopics: Regulation: EU AI Act risk classes and India's DPDP Act
days.lab_task: Threat-model the assistant against the OWASP LLM Top 10, fix the three highest risks, set retention rules for prompts and logs and write the data flow record.
days.deliverable: Threat model, fixes, retention configuration and data flow record
checks: Map each OWASP LLM risk to the design
Every risk has a status and owner
Check logs after the retention period
Shows where personal data goes and why

days.topic: Generative AI Product Delivery: Pilots to Production
days.lab_task: Run an A/B test of two assistant versions with simulated users, analyse quality, satisfaction and cost, and write a go or no-go recommendation for production.
days.deliverable: A/B test results and a go or no-go memo
checks: Support, monitoring and rollback are covered

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Production Customer Support Assistant
subtopics: RAG with hybrid search and citations
days.lab_task: Deliver a support assistant that answers from documents with citations, looks up and changes orders through safe tools, passes CI evaluation, has guardrails and tracing, meets a cost budget and is deployed to a cloud, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, CI evaluation report, dashboards, deployment and a 15-minute demo
checks: Run the evaluation suite in CI
Ask for a refund above the limit
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one product

advanced.summary: For engineers who build LLM applications in production. Covers model internals, training and alignment, serving at scale, advanced retrieval and agents, evaluation science, security, governance, LLMOps platforms and the economics of generative AI.
prerequisites: Has shipped an LLM application with RAG or tools
Writes Python and works with cloud services
Understands evaluation and basic machine learning ideas
outcomes: Explain transformer internals and make informed model choices
Fine-tune, align and serve models efficiently
Build and govern enterprise generative AI platforms
Evaluate, secure and run LLM systems at scale

days.topic: Transformer Architecture in Depth
subtopics: Reading a model card and config
days.lab_task: Implement single-head attention in PyTorch, load a small open model, inspect its attention patterns and KV cache size, and estimate memory for a 32k-token context.
days.deliverable: Notebook with attention code, visualisations and memory estimate
checks: Compare your attention output with the library's
Estimate KV cache memory for 32k tokens
Estimate matches measured usage within 20 percent
Explain mixture of experts from a model card

days.topic: Pre-Training, Instruction Tuning and Alignment
days.lab_task: Run direct preference optimisation on a small model with a provided preference dataset, compare outputs before and after on 30 prompts and measure helpfulness and refusal changes.
days.deliverable: Training run, comparison set and evaluation report
checks: Compare preferred-response rate before and after
Explain reward hacking with an example from the run or literature

days.topic: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning at Scale
subtopics: Multi-GPU training with DeepSpeed or FSDP
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a 7B-class model with QLoRA on a domain dataset, track experiments, compare three ranks, then serve two adapters from one vLLM instance.
days.deliverable: Training configs, experiment dashboard and multi-adapter serving demo
checks: Compare three ranks on the test set
Serve two adapters from one server
Requests route to the right adapter

days.topic: Synthetic Data Generation and Data Curation
days.lab_task: Generate 5,000 synthetic question-answer pairs from company documents, filter and deduplicate them, check that no test questions leaked in and measure the effect on a fine-tuned model.
days.deliverable: Generation pipeline, curated dataset and effect report
checks: Check overlap with the test set
Compare models trained with and without synthetic data

days.topic: High-Throughput Model Serving and Inference Optimisation
subtopics: Quantisation for serving: INT8, INT4, FP8
days.lab_task: Benchmark an open model under load with and without quantisation and speculative decoding, tune batching and compute cost per million tokens for each setup.
days.deliverable: Benchmark report and recommended serving configuration
checks: Load-test the baseline and the optimised setup
Run the quality test set on the quantised model

days.topic: Advanced Retrieval: GraphRAG, Agentic Retrieval and Long Context
subtopics: Retrieval as a tool for agents
days.lab_task: Build a knowledge graph from a set of contracts, answer 20 multi-hop questions with GraphRAG, plain RAG and a long-context model, and compare accuracy and cost.
days.deliverable: Graph, three pipelines and a comparison report
checks: Answer the 20 multi-hop questions with each approach
Inspect the graph for one contract
Parties, dates and obligations are linked correctly
objectives: Choose between retrieval and long context

days.topic: Agent Architectures for Production
days.lab_task: Rebuild a multi-step claims-handling workflow as a LangGraph agent with explicit states, human approval for payments and evaluation on 30 scenarios, comparing it with a free-form agent.
days.deliverable: Agent code, state diagram and scenario evaluation

days.topic: Evaluation Science for LLM Systems
days.lab_task: Compare two model versions on 300 questions with pairwise judging, compute confidence intervals, measure judge position bias and write an evaluation report that states its limits.
days.deliverable: Evaluation code, statistics and report
checks: Swap answer order for the judge
Report says whether the difference is significant
Limits and test set coverage are stated

days.topic: Red Teaming and Adversarial Testing of LLMs
subtopics: Indirect prompt injection in RAG and agents
days.lab_task: Run an automated and a manual red-team exercise against the capstone assistant from the intermediate level, score findings by severity, fix the top three and retest.
days.deliverable: Red-team report with findings, fixes and retest results

days.topic: Enterprise Generative AI Platform and Gateway Design
days.lab_task: Deploy an AI gateway that routes requests from three teams to approved models, enforces quotas, masks personal data, logs usage and produces a monthly cost report per team.
days.deliverable: Gateway configuration, quota tests and cost report
checks: Requests are rejected for that team only

days.topic: LLMOps: CI/CD for Prompts, Models and Data
subtopics: Monitoring drift in inputs and quality
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that versions the prompt, model and index together, runs evaluation gates, releases to 10 percent of traffic, watches quality metrics and rolls back automatically on a drop.
days.deliverable: Pipeline definition, release record and rollback demo
checks: Canary detects the drop and rolls back
Rebuild the index from the recorded version
Look up the version of a production answer
Prompt, model and index versions are traceable
objectives: Trace every answer to its versions

days.topic: Responsible AI Governance and Regulation
subtopics: AI risk management frameworks: NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001
EU AI Act obligations by risk class
India's DPDP Act and sector rules
days.lab_task: Classify three company AI systems under the EU AI Act, complete an impact assessment and a system card for the highest-risk one, and list the controls needed for audit.
days.deliverable: Classification, impact assessment, system card and control list
checks: Classes justified against the regulation text
Covers purpose, data, limits, evaluation and oversight

days.topic: Privacy-Preserving and On-Premises Generative AI
subtopics: Personal data removal from training sets
days.lab_task: Design and build an on-premises assistant that runs with no internet access, removes personal data from its documents before indexing and meets a stated data residency rule.
days.deliverable: Architecture, deployment and privacy test results
checks: Search the index for planted personal data
Compare on-premises and cloud cost for the stated load
objectives: Run generative AI without sending data out

days.topic: Multimodal and Speech Systems at Scale
days.lab_task: Build a real-time voice assistant that answers questions from documents with under 1.5 seconds response time, and measure transcription accuracy and answer quality on 30 calls.
days.deliverable: Voice assistant, latency report and evaluation results
checks: Recorded and compared with a target
Interrupt the assistant while it speaks

days.topic: Small Language Models and Edge Deployment
subtopics: Running models on CPUs and phones
days.lab_task: Distil a classification task from a large model into a small model, run it on a CPU-only device with llama.cpp or ONNX and compare accuracy, speed and size with the large model.
days.deliverable: Distilled model, device benchmark and comparison
checks: Compare accuracy with the large model
objectives: Use small models where they fit

days.topic: Content Provenance, Watermarking and Copyright
subtopics: Copyright questions for training data and outputs
Detecting AI-generated content and its limits
days.lab_task: Add C2PA content credentials to generated marketing images, test two AI-text detectors on 40 human and AI texts, and write a publishing policy based on the results.
days.deliverable: Signed images, detector test results and a publishing policy
checks: Inspect a signed image with a C2PA verifier
Credentials show the generator and edits
Run both detectors on the 40 texts
objectives: Track the origin of generated content

days.topic: Economics of Generative AI
days.lab_task: Build a three-year cost model for an AI feature comparing API use and self-hosting at three traffic levels, find the break-even point and present a recommendation to leadership.
days.deliverable: Cost model and a five-slide recommendation
checks: Model updates and the effect is explained

days.topic: Generative AI Incident Management and Production Troubleshooting
subtopics: Rolling back prompts, models and indexes
days.lab_task: Handle three injected incidents (a hallucination spike after an index change, a provider outage and a cost spike from a loop), restore service, find root causes and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident timelines, fixes and runbooks
checks: Restore answer quality after the index incident
Traffic moves to the fallback model
Find the cause of the cost spike

days.topic: Generative AI Strategy and Architecture Reviews
days.lab_task: Review two proposed generative AI designs from a provided case study, find their main risks, write architecture decision records and present a recommendation to a mock architecture board.
days.deliverable: Review notes, decision records and presentation
checks: List the risks in each design
Each has options, trade-offs and a decision

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Generative AI Platform
